name: octocode-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for advanced GitHub repository analysis and code discovery. Provides AI assistants with powerful tools to search, analyze, and understand codebases across GitHub.
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.build: yarn readme:sync && yarn clean && node ../../scripts/esbuild-package.mjs && yarn build:types && node scripts/bundle-docs.mjs
scripts.build:bin: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --outfile dist/octocode-mcp && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs darwin-arm64 dist
scripts.build:bin:all: bun run build:bin:linux-x64 && bun run build:bin:linux-arm64 && bun run build:bin:linux-x64-musl && bun run build:bin:darwin-arm64 && bun run build:bin:darwin-x64 && bun run build:bin:windows-x64
scripts.build:bin:darwin-arm64: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/octocode-mcp-darwin-arm64 && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs darwin-arm64 dist
scripts.build:bin:darwin-x64: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/octocode-mcp-darwin-x64 && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs darwin-x64 dist
scripts.build:bin:linux-arm64: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/octocode-mcp-linux-arm64 && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs linux-arm64 dist
scripts.build:bin:linux-x64: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/octocode-mcp-linux-x64 && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs linux-x64 dist
scripts.build:bin:linux-x64-musl: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-linux-x64-musl --outfile dist/octocode-mcp-linux-x64-musl && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs linux-x64-musl dist
scripts.build:bin:windows-x64: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/octocode-mcp-windows-x64.exe && node scripts/bundle-engine.mjs windows-x64 dist
scripts.build:dev: yarn readme:sync && yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-tools-core build:dev && OCTOCODE_RUNTIME_PLATFORMS=native node ../../scripts/esbuild-package.mjs && yarn build:types && node scripts/bundle-docs.mjs
scripts.mcp:package: yarn lint && yarn typecheck:full && yarn test:contracts
scripts.test:contracts:providers: OCTOCODE_ENFORCE_WARNING_FREE_TESTS=1 node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/index.test.ts tests/index.shutdown.test.ts tests/serverConfig*.test.ts tests/tools/providerExecution.test.ts
scripts.test:contracts:startup: OCTOCODE_ENFORCE_WARNING_FREE_TESTS=1 node ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/index.test.ts tests/index.shutdown.test.ts tests/serverConfig*.test.ts
